panels.title: Pobieranie wg urządzenia
panels.description: Średnia prędkość pobierania (kb/s) w przedziałach 5-minutowych, wg danych routera.

targets.queryText:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', o.ts) AS INTEGER) / 300) * 300 AS time,
  COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, o.mac) AS device,
  ROUND(AVG(o.down_kbps), 1) AS kbps
FROM device_observations o
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = o.mac
WHERE o.down_kbps IS NOT NULL AND o.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND o.ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
